_comment: The Spirit readout (see include/SpiritHud.h) -- the corner total, and the '+N' a gain announces itself with before feeding into it. x/y are window fractions (top-left origin); pad is a canvas fraction. catch_up is the FRACTION of the remaining gap the shown number closes each frame (higher = snappier), min_step stops the last few units crawling. gain_hold/gain_fade are seconds the '+N' stays lit / takes to fade, gain_rise how far it drifts up as it goes (canvas fraction). Tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source).
